project.core_setting: Ancient North India / Magadha era (Syncretic Buddhist & Hindu Aesthetics)
project.elevator_pitch: The wheel turns by itself; your only window out is a single human life. Reincarnate by karma, live card-driven lives, face the bardo, and try to break the 12 links of dependent origination in one lifetime.

design_pillars: The wheel is a system: rules are deduced through lived lives; knowledge is meta-progression
Suffering is the only source of wisdom: dukkha generates prajna, comfort generates only punya
Motivation outweighs action: same deed from craving/aversion/delusion yields different karmic traces
Nothing fully disappears: death wipes resources, not samskaras and not prajna
Honest trap: every hidden mechanic signals itself in advance

life_phases.note: partly determined by karma and parents' Karma Score
life paths unlock (family / wanderer / merchant / ascetic...)
resource allocation; main punya/papa deals; key nidana events
reflection (+1 prajna if prajna >= 10), preparation for death

core_loop.act_structure: 2-4 options; each option = action + intention (two-step choice)

primary_resources.punya: Good karma: improves next-birth conditions, but risks the Deva Realm Trap
primary_resources.papa: Bad karma: drags to lower realms, offers quick short-term tactical advantages
primary_resources.prajna: Wisdom/awareness: persistent across deaths; required for Nirvana; cannot be bought

trap_of_good_karma.summary: High punya leads to the Deva Realm; no suffering means no prajna; eventual fall to lower realms
trap_of_good_karma.details: In Deva realm punya is spent on existence itself (-1 per 2 acts); prajna decays (-1 per 6 acts); at punya < 8 the 'Five Signs' herald the fall

twelve_nidanas.rule: All 12 must be broken within a single lifetime (human realm only)
twelve_nidanas.visibility: Links become visible bottom-up; deep links (samskara, avidya) visible only after breaking tanha
twelve_nidanas.weak_seams: Links broken in past lives re-tie at birth but cost half to break again

false_enlightenment.summary: Internal motivation validation; fake asceticism out of aversion disturbs the mind and sends the player to the Preta Realm
false_enlightenment.generosity_from_craving: +punya, +0 prajna, increments merit-craving counter (accelerates Deva entry)

the_middle_way.note: Extremes give short-term bonuses; equanimity ('Buddha's smile' at zero) maximizes prajna

karmic_echo.summary: Samskaras from past lives set up an auto-pilot: auto-choices, accelerated timers, highlighted negative options

manusha.focus: full option set; only realm where nidanas can be broken

naraka.papa_burn: -2 per act (contested design, see open questions)

moksha_hindu_vector.summary: Dissolution into the Absolute / Brahma realm; temporary high-tier state lasting aeons before resetting into Samsara
moksha_hindu_vector.persistent_bonus: Memory of the Heights (+1 prajna at start of subsequent lives)

nirvana_buddhist_vector.summary: Realization of anatman; extinguishing of craving; complete silence, true escape without traditional win metrics
nirvana_buddhist_vector.requirement: break avidya within a human life
nirvana_buddhist_vector.post_credits: option to watch the wheel keep turning without the player

bodhisattva_hidden.summary: Conscious refusal of available Nirvana; return for the sake of others
bodhisattva_hidden.requirement: 6 vows (lives where prajna was spent on others' suffering instead of one's own breaking)

economy_targets.rng_policy: deck-based with pity: guaranteed suffering at most once per N acts, at least once per life

open_questions: Should intention roots (lobha/dvesha/moha) be shown before the choice, or only in bardo/codex?
Naraka as purifying fire (papa burn) is elegant but theologically contested; needs consultation
Real toponyms (Magadha, Rajagriha) vs fictional analogue
Should punya/papa numbers be visible (readability) or hidden (emergence)?
Deva aeons: stretched acts or compressed timelapse?

roadmap.scope: paper balance prototype; scripted life simulation; economy calibration
playable: human life, resources, death, rebirth (Human/Animal/Deva)
bardo, samskaras, intention system, Preta trigger
12 nidanas, dharma codex, both endings + bodhisattva
content (60-80 events), all 6 realms, audio, polish, RU/EN localization

tech_sketch: Browser, no backend: TypeScript + (Svelte|React) or Ink-like text engine; events as JSON; localStorage saves; offline-friendly; Vite build
